definitions.gloss: judge (of a contest); examiner; judging-panel member
definitions.explanation: A person who evaluates entries in a competition, contest, or examination and decides on results or scores. Common for contests, auditions, art exhibitions, and qualification screenings.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{審査員|しんさいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I served as a judge for the contest.

examples.japanese: {審査員|しんさいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The judges evaluated the works one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{審査員|しんさいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: That teacher, known as a strict judge, gave high marks this time.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (examination, screening) + {員|いん} (member, staff).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {審査員|しんさいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a judge
- {審査員|しんさいん}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: head judge; chief examiner
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{審査員|しんさいん}: special / guest judge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧: referee; umpire — judges play and fouls in sports rather than scoring artistic or competitive entries
- ⟦{選考|せんこう}→選考：03774_senkou⟧⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧: selection committee member — chooses among applicants (jobs, awards) rather than scoring a performance
